blocks.text: I’d choose the earlier-arriving Aeroplan award: it reaches Bangkok sooner and has a shorter TPE connection than the later award. The tradeoff is departing San Francisco earlier. These are selected examples from partial search results, not a complete view of availability; confirm current award availability and prices before booking.

blocks.text: Compared with the later award below, this option arrives 15 hours 25 minutes earlier and has 3 hours 55 minutes less elapsed travel time. It also departs SFO 11 hours 30 minutes earlier. Those are distinct schedule differences, not a claim about arrival difference based on elapsed time.
